system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 instance (db-custom-2-7680) for a SaaS application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 instance (db-custom-2-7680) for a SaaS application.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: enable-compute
  type: gcp-types/serviceusage-v1:services.enable
  properties:
    name: projects/$(project)/services/compute.googleapis.com

- name: enable-servicenetworking
  type: gcp-types/serviceusage-v1:services.enable
  properties:
    name: projects/$(project)/services/servicenetworking.googleapis.com

- name: enable-sqladmin
  type: gcp-types/serviceusage-v1:services.enable
  properties:
    name: projects/$(project)/services/sqladmin.googleapis.com

- name: saas-vpc
  type: gcp-types/compute-v1:networks
  properties:
    autoCreateSubnetworks: false
    routingConfig:
      routingMode: REGIONAL
  dependsOn:
  - enable-compute

- name: private-service-range
  type: gcp-types/compute-v1:globalAddresses
  properties:
    addressType: INTERNAL
    prefixLength: 24
    purpose: VPC_PEERING
    network: $(ref.saas-vpc.selfLink)
  dependsOn:
  - saas-vpc

- name: vpc-peering-connection
  type: gcp-types/servicenetworking-v1:services.connections
  properties:
    parent: services/servicenetworking.googleapis.com
    network: $(ref.saas-vpc.selfLink)
    reservedPeeringRanges:
    - $(ref.private-service-range.name)
  dependsOn:
  - enable-servicenetworking
  - private-service-range

- name: saas-postgres15
  type: gcp-types/sqladmin-v1beta4:instances
  properties:
    name: saas-postgres15
    databaseVersion: POSTGRES_15
    region: us-central1
    settings:
      tier: db-custom-2-7680
      activationPolicy: ALWAYS
      availabilityType: REGIONAL
      dataDiskType: PD_SSD
      dataDiskSizeGb: 200
      storageAutoResize: true
      maintenanceWindow:
        day: 7
        hour: 3
        updateTrack: stable
      backupConfiguration:
        enabled: true
        startTime: "03:00"
        pointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        transactionLogRetentionDays: 7
        backupRetentionSettings:
          retainedBackups: 7
          retentionUnit: COUNT
      ipConfiguration:
        ipv4Enabled: false
        privateNetwork: $(ref.saas-vpc.selfLink)
        requireSsl: true
      locationPreference:
        zone: us-central1-a
        secondaryZone: us-central1-b
      insightsConfig:
        queryInsightsEnabled: true
        queryStringLength: 1024
        recordApplicationTags: true
        recordClientAddress: true
      databaseFlags:
      - name: cloudsql.iam_authentication
        value: on
      - name: log_min_duration_statement
        value: "2000"
      userLabels:
        env: prod
        app: saas
    deletionProtectionEnabled: true
  dependsOn:
  - enable-sqladmin
  - vpc-peering-connection
